auto-chunker.meaning: Auto-detects chunking needs and splits requests by complexity and token weight
auto-chunker.rule: Use auto-chunker when split chunk complex request.

cell-bootstrap.meaning: Multi-source bootstrap — tries github/hive/interlink/skill in priority order
cell-bootstrap.rule: Use cell-bootstrap when bootstrap install init.

intake-engine.meaning: Gatekeeper — routes prompts, approves AI involvement
intake-engine.rule: Use intake-engine when add build discuss micro.

dataset-store.meaning: Manages DuckDB datasets for chat-contracts, chat-logs, hive-events, node-registry, request-log, script-registry
dataset-store.rule: Use dataset-store when store log query dataset.

factory-cli.meaning: CLI entry point — routes commands to appropriate forges
factory-cli.rule: Use factory-cli when list scan run capture.

heartbeat.meaning: Periodic tick orchestrator — runs train cars on each interval
heartbeat.rule: Use heartbeat when tick interval periodic.

hive-api.meaning: Hive distribution API — serves manifest, nodes, events

hive-dispatcher.meaning: Pulls pending chunks from a cell and dispatches them for execution

hive-receive.meaning: Hive endpoint — handles cell registration, chunk dispatch, heartbeat, status queries
hive-receive.rule: Use hive-receive when register dispatch heartbeat.

talkback.meaning: Reports node status and pending chunk count back to the hive

scan-workspace.meaning: Scans workspace and builds codebase tree artifact

heartbeat-car.meaning: Train car — fires GET /api/hive?status=1 with cell identity on each tick

spawn-worker-car.meaning: Train car — spawns a worker for each pending chunk on the dispatch queue
spawn-worker-car.rule: Use spawn-worker-car when spawn worker dispatch.

scan-workspace-car.meaning: Train car — re-runs scan-workspace if last scan is stale (>24h)
scan-workspace-car.rule: Use scan-workspace-car when scan gaps workspace.

hive-sync-car.meaning: Train car — pulls latest manifest from hive and updates local packages if newer

Scriptonomy.DISCUSS: Free-form AI chat — bypasses scripts, no gate
Scriptonomy.MICRO: ≤1 file mutation — fires directly, no gate

BootstrapSources.github: git clone from canonical repo — default source
BootstrapSources.hive: pull packages from registered Hive via /api/hive — Cell bootstrap
BootstrapSources.interlink: Zo-to-Zo ask API — direct from director Zo — emergency/override

HiveCellArchitecture.Hive: Distribution hub — owns manifest, receives heartbeats, dispatches work
HiveCellArchitecture.Cell: A Zo registered to a Hive — fires heartbeats, receives dispatches
HiveCellArchitecture.Terminal: A standalone Zo not connected to any Hive
